text:
Mother, Mother, you kiss me,
but I kiss you more,
and the swarm of my kisses
will not even let you look…


When the bee enters the lily,
its fluttering cannot be heard.
When you hide your little one,
even his breathing is unheard…


I look at you, I look at you,
never tired of looking,
and what a lovely child I see
appearing in your eyes…


The pond copies all
that you are looking at;
but in your little girls you have
your son and nothing else.


The little eyes you gave me
I must wear away
following you through valleys,
through sky and sea…

translation.title: Mother, Mother, You Kiss Me...
